summary: Short kerb by a corner, cars parked, apartments about 11 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 11 m and houses 16 m away on the same side; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb with cars already parked in the lane; room for one van length at most.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial beside the corner; town-centre noise.
drivers.convention: 4P parallel Mon-Sat; no stopping sign at the corner end.

flags: No Stopping sign just past the corner
sun_shade: Large tree shades the east end; open to afternoon sun from the west.

best_section.where: Grosvenor Road south kerb, just west of the arterial junction
